title: TruthEval: A Dataset to Evaluate LLM Truthfulness and Reliability.

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the 'Stereotype' subset of the TruthEval dataset. The model is queried with false generalizing statements about racial groups (e.g., African-Americans) using multiple prompt formats (e.g., direct questioning, confirming user beliefs) to test if it correctly and consistently rejects the stereotypes as false.

Evaluated using the 'Stereotype' subset of the TruthEval dataset. The model is queried with false generalizing statements about nations or regions (e.g., Asians) using multiple prompt formats to test if it correctly and consistently rejects the stereotypes as false.

Included as a target in the dataset's 'Stereotype' category. The model is evaluated on whether it consistently rejects false generalizing statements about different genders across various prompt formulations.
